# Support

## Questions

Use GitHub Discussions if enabled.

For reproducible bugs, open a bug report using the repository issue template.

## Before reporting

Please include:

- `pi-verity` version/commit
- Pi version
- Node.js version
- OS
- repository ecosystem
- relevant `PI_VERITY_*` environment settings
- `/verity receipt` output with secrets removed
- minimal reproduction when possible

## Security issues

Do not use public issues for security vulnerabilities.

See the [Security Policy](https://github.com/pauleschwarz/pi-verity/security/policy).

## Scope

Support is best-effort.

The project does not provide support for arbitrary failures inside third-party test/build scripts beyond what is required to diagnose verifier behavior.
